rules.rule: Flag any changed path that accepts unsupported releaseClass/version/channel combinations, fails open on malformed registry responses or unsafe npm configuration, or bypasses the authorization/CI gates required for publishing. Give a concrete rejected-before/accepted-after example.

Flag a path that publishes a mixed class-major batch, unconditionally moves dist-tags, leaks credentials, or treats partial npm publication as an atomic success. Trace the affected external side effect.

Flag a test or fixture update that masks a failure of the guard's class-major, registry, or Changesets checks, especially the pinned Changesets CLI/Bun workspace semantics. Require a concrete false-pass scenario.
